title: The Sick Well
text: The town well has turned brackish, green scum on the bucket. The children who drank from it dream of drowning and wake coughing up river weed. The physicians have traced the sickness to a nest beyond the Gate, in the Drowned Marches, where it must be cleansed at the source.

options.label: Seal the well until it is cleansed, whatever the water costs meanwhile.

outcomes.text: Water comes dear and slow by cart from the river. The children stop dreaming.

options.label: Boil it and keep drinking; the city cannot go without water.

outcomes.text: It tastes of iron, but it holds.
The dreams spread from house to house, and more children wake coughing weed.

options.label: Have it blessed at the Shrine so the city sees you try.

outcomes.text: Every night the priests sing over it. It helps the singers at least, and the city sees them try.
